title: Sea Foam Green Paper Towel Holder, 14-Inch Freestanding Solid Brass Countertop Valet Stand, 5 X 14 X 5, Allied Brass
description: Paper towel holder for kitchen countertops, 14 inches tall (14-inch, 14in) with 5 inches length x 5 inches width (5 x 14 x 5) — available in Sea Foam Green that which captures the tranquil essence of ocean-inspired design, bringing soft, natural color to coastal and contemporary spaces. Freestanding, countertop paper towel stand / paper towel valet made from solid brass (brass construction) with a weighted base to prevent tipping. Felt pad helps prevent scratching on surfaces. Contemporary, modern crisp style for a clean look on islands, prep counters, and coffee stations. No wall mount needed (freestanding design). Includes paper towel holder. Designer finish provides corrosion-free and rust-free performance. Limited lifetime warranty. Allied Brass.
